R. Yishmael explicitly says to Akiva that Akiva served Naḥum twenty-two years.
The duration is explicit in Ḥagigah; Shevuot separately describes Akiva’s method as learned from Naḥum.
Akiva served Naḥum. The same passage names Neḥunya ben HaKanah as Yishmael’s teacher, without excluding another relationship.

The matching paragraph of Gilgulei Neshamot begins with the same Lot identification and makes the same chain of comparisons. The retelling in Heilprin has additional details.
The identified kabbalistic source uses ibbur as the soul-related term in this interpretation of Naḥum’s sufferings. Keep it attributed to that work.
The Bavli relates theft of gems and pearls and victory by means of the earth. Gold is the wording of Heilprin’s retelling.
The kabbalistic comparison follows the Bavli’s interpretation of the earth and Abraham’s sword; Genesis supplies the rescue context.
